se.annihilationblade.dankong.desc: Locks hostile targets in range, blinks through them in sequence, leaves terminus cuts behind, then returns to the origin. Hold Shift to interrupt; Left Ctrl toggles blink mode while holding Annihilation Blade.
se.annihilationblade.world_rift.desc: Tears a rift wound into the struck target, drags nearby hostile targets into the rupture, and executes them. Pull radius, target cap, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.terminus_echo.desc: Sends layered terminus echoes forward, forming repeated horizontal cuts that sweep through enemies like a fading refrain. Range, width, wave count, interval, cooldown, and target cap are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.void_dominion.desc: Unfolds a void dominion in front of the player, marks hostile targets inside the area, and erases them one by one. Domain range, target cap, cooldown, and visual scale are configurable.
Collapses causality from the first struck target, searches the nearest hostile targets, then creates anchors and slash bridges before chain execution. Chain radius, chain cap, cooldown, and visual scale are configurable.
Projects a wide starless judgement wave forward, checks targets along its projected path, and delivers the heaven-cleaving verdict. Range, width, target cap, cooldown, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.phantom_judgement.d: Summons orbiting phantom blades to lock scattered targets, then calls down dense sword rain for focused judgement. Search duration, orbiting sword count, falling sword count, lingering time, target cap, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.abyssal_decree.desc: Builds an abyssal star crown above the player, prioritizes hostile targets, and drops decree strikes from above one by one. Search range, target cap, strike interval, cooldown, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.blood_leech.desc: A core Blood Prison passive. Hostile hits turn the wielder's health into both risk and leverage, trading high-pressure melee for lifesteal sustain. Lifesteal and damage logic are fixed.
se.annihilationblade.spirit_shield.desc: Blood Prison's emergency safeguard. When health falls too low, it unfolds a spirit shield and short buffs to stabilize the wielder. Shield safety logic is fixed.
se.annihilationblade.phantom_mark.desc: Blood Prison's hunting mark. Repeated hits stack phantom marks; when they burst, phantom blades tear into the target. Burst sword count, delay, visual radius, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.entropy_dissolution: Every valid hit removes an additional 10% of the target's max health. Ten marks force heat-death execution and erase non-player targets at code level.
se.annihilationblade.curvature_rupture.d: Disabled by default; press I to toggle. While enabled and holding Infinity Stellaris, legal targets within 25 blocks that pass SlashBlade PVP/friendly-fire rules are forced still and Mob AI is temporarily disabled; AI is restored after the blade is no longer held or the toggle is turned off.
Infinity Stellaris damage triggers Gamma Thunderburst: 12 random colored lightning bolts fall within 128 blocks around the wielder once per tick for 3 ticks.
se.annihilationblade.cosmic_string_cut.d: Triggers through SlashBlade's native slash event instead of sneak-right-click, then cuts legal targets in a 128-block cube and calls final execution.
se.annihilationblade.demonic_blood_paras: Valid hits and Nightfall summoned swords, excluding Outer God Scar, Reverse Scale Hunt, and final-form Dragon Blade swords, stack unbounded Demonic Blood, apply Wither up to V and Blindness, add 5% max-health magic damage, and turn marked follow-up hits into true damage; every 20 Abyssal Flame marks call a falling phantom-sword burst.
se.annihilationblade.outer_god_scar.desc: Sealed-form slashes create purple void scars and companion summoned swords that dance around the wielder before hunting legal targets.
se.annihilationblade.dragon_pressure_dom: Awakened form grants Speed III, Strength III, Night Vision III, and Absorption III while held. Final form inherits Speed, Strength, and Night Vision, while Creation Dragon Shield replaces the lower absorption layer.
Awakened slashes release gold-and-purple reverse-scale swords with stronger speed and pierce, while Dragon Scale Shelter grants Resistance III.
se.annihilationblade.dragon_god_body.des: Final form in inventory grants death-lock protection, harmful-effect cleansing, void fallback, flight, law reflection, lifesteal, Creation Dragon Shield capped at 200 health, and heavily reduced god-body aura particles.
se.annihilationblade.absolute_annihilati: Final form unfolds a throttled 64-block dragon domain every second, stripping buffs and absorption from legal targets, freezing them, dealing 25% current-health magic damage plus fixed true pressure, and executing targets below half health.
se.annihilationblade.myriad_dragon_blade: Final slashes summon twenty dark-gold and star-violet dragon blades that hunt legal targets up to 96 blocks away.
se.annihilationblade.world_cleaving_slas: Final normal slashes add a 72-block wide void blade wave that pulls legal enemies into the scar, suppresses attacks, delivers overwhelming magic damage, and calls up to 16 purple Gamma thunderbolts.

item.annihilationblade.desc.line3: §8"§dSevered space, wounded worlds, and the last refrain of the end.§8"

jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.annihil: Annihilation Blade is a named blade built around terminus execution, rift chaining, and large-scale visual impact. Spatial Fracture opens the battlefield, while Severed Space, World Rift, Terminus Echo, Void Dominion, Causality Collapse, Starless Judgement, Phantom Judgement, and Abyssal Decree pull enemy groups layer by layer into the end. It favors area suppression, chained clearing, and strong combat feedback.
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.blood_p: Demonic Blade: Blood Prison is a named blade built around health risk, a blood-red domain, and phantom pursuit. Infernal Slaughter opens the domain and blinks through targets, Blood Leech sustains the wielder, Spirit Shield protects the danger window, and Phantom Mark converts repeated hits into burst damage. Compared with Annihilation Blade, it leans harder into close-range pressure.
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.infinit: Infinity Stellaris is a craftable final weapon with a deliberately extreme ritual recipe: four Annihilation Cores, a Dragon Egg, two Beacons, one Nether Star, and a Blood Prison with 5000 kills, 25000 Proud Souls, and 50 refine. Its wielder receives flight, invulnerability, death fallback, and gamma fullbright. Hits trigger entropy dissolution, a 5-tick particle chain, and custom colored Gamma Thunderburst. Cosmic String Cut triggers through SlashBlade's native SE slash flow; Curvature Rupture is disabled by default, can be toggled with I, only freezes legal targets that pass SlashBlade PVP/friendly-fire rules, and restores AI after Infinity Stellaris is no longer held. Its SA creates a 128x128 Absolute Annihilation Zone at the aimed point, killing legal targets inside with no drops.
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.nightfa: Nightfall Dragon is a three-form demonic-dragon named blade. Z cycles Sealed, Awakened, and Final. Sealed form has Nightfall Judgement Cut: it scans legal targets within 20 blocks and spawns one Judgement Cut every 5 ticks at target feet or random fallback points until 20 cuts appear. Awakened form has Scale Guard: 16 upright phantom blades orbit, expand, pause, rise, and slam down, dealing touch damage during flight and 500% blade panel damage plus 10% max-health damage on impact with camera shake. Final form in inventory grants god-body survival and flight; held final form keeps slash_art as slashblade:none, inherits non-duplicate Demonic Blood and Dragon Pressure traits, and adds Creation God Body, Domain of Absolute Annihilation, Myriad Dragon Blade Storm, and World-Cleaving Slash. Lower companion-sword patterns are replaced by the final blade storm and piercing blade wave, with final-form visual particles capped at 500 per level tick.
